test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: In which of the following states has the Sanhati Programme been launched which will enable around 1.5 lakh students to avail primary education in their mother tongue?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik launched the 'Sanhati Programme' which will enable around 1.5 lakh students to avail primary education in their mother tongue.
 
• The Odisha government has also credited Rs 101 crore towards Post Matric Scholarship to the bank accounts of around 50,000 students.
 
• The chief minister also launched the 'Mo Chhatrabasa' card for students staying at hostels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chief Minister - Naveen Patnaik. (May 2022)
 
• Governor - Ganeshi Lal.
 
• Number of Districts - 30.
